answer: Trust can flow outward from a small seed set of verified agents, like water seeping through karst: each hop through the vouching graph halves the trust passed on, and a vouch only counts if a quartz-hard bond of staked tokens backs it. A Sybil farm can mint a thousand identities, but they reach honest agents through only a few attack edges, so little trust trickles in. To climb toward the summit of reputation, the attacker must buy real endorsements, each one risking a slashed bond.
